up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for human single-protein target CHEMBL2007628 (Tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 5). Required data: assay.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value. Filters: activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, assays.assay_organism = 'Human' (via target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606), target_dictionary.tid = 2007628, activities.standard_relation = '='. Ranking: order by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, m.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary m ON a.molecule_chembl_id = m.chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.tid = 2007628
  AND td.tax_id = 9606
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
ORDER BY m.chembl_id ASC, a.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
